El desbordamiento no es una curiosidad d: Overflow is not an exam curiosity. On 4 June 1996, the first flight of the Ariane 5 rocket destroyed itself forty seconds after lift-off. The cause was a conversion: a horizontal velocity measurement stored in 64-bit floating point was converted to a 16-bit integer, and it did not fit. The program was correct and came tested from the Ariane 4, where that velocity never got so high; the Ariane 5 was faster. Nobody had checked what happened if the number did not fit, because in the previous rocket it could not happen.

La aritmética binaria la publicó <strong: Binary arithmetic was published by Gottfried Leibniz in 1703, in a paper of the Paris Academy of Sciences, and he was delighted to discover that the hexagrams of the Chinese I Ching, sent to him by the Jesuit Joachim Bouvet, could be read as numbers in base two. Leibniz had no machine to use it on. The word bit is much later: it was proposed by the statistician John Tukey as a contraction of binary digit, and the one who put it into circulation was Claude Shannon by citing him in his 1948 paper, the same one that founded [[av-informacion|information theory]].
La gracia del invento está en una compro: The beauty of the invention is in a five-second check: $00000101 + 11111011 = 100000000$, and since the ninth bit does not fit in the byte, it falls off and $00000000$ remains.
